components.name: Refresh button
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #394148;border-radius:7px;background:#24292e;color:#e0e6ea;font:12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-button:hover{background:#30383e;border-color:#56616b;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8de0cd;outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:wait;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out;}}

components.name: Quiet button
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #394148;border-radius:7px;background:#24292e;color:#e0e6ea;font:12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-button:hover{background:#30383e;border-color:#56616b;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8de0cd;outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:wait;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out;}}.ds-quiet{background:transparent;border-color:transparent;color:#a0a9b2;}

components.name: Report action
components.description: Opens and focuses the selected project report.
components.css: .ds-report{border:0;background:transparent;color:#8de0cd;font:12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:10px 0 10px 8px;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:transparent;text-underline-offset:4px;cursor:pointer;}.ds-report:hover{text-decoration-color:currentColor;}.ds-report:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8de0cd;outline-offset:4px;}

narrative.overview:
The administrator dashboard is a sleek, modern dark shell for unreel content’s private, read-only agency metrics workspace. Charcoal surfaces, restrained mint accents, clear totals and a project-first directory implement the user’s chosen direction. This is a code-led record of the delivered dashboard, not a broader brand identity.

Scope is administrator chrome on /admin only. Individual client/project themes and report visual styles are out of scope and inherited unchanged. Unthemed reports retain the default light palette; custom project themes are authoritative through project-theme.css and data-project-theme. The admin wrapper isolates report content and provides surrounding spacing. Product context comes from README.md; no PRODUCT.md or additional interview decisions are assumed.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal surfaces with restrained mint navigation and report actions.
Clear totals, aligned project rows and compact supporting text.
Responsive navigation and keyboard-accessible table scrolling.
dos: Do keep administrator colors scoped to the administrator shell.
Do preserve visible focus, status text and accessible table labels.
Do use the existing SVG stroke icons and tabular numerals for totals.
donts: Don’t apply this palette or typography scale to individual client/project themes or report content.
Don’t imply that dashboard controls can edit business data; this workspace is read-only.
